newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds business capped by strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: European feeds business capped by strong dollar.

text.p: European feeds activity remained capped by the strong dollar on Wednesday, with buyers filling in cover gaps with a little nearby material but staying away from substantial purchases.

Physical traders on the continent said a firm opening to Chicago trading had been expected, but price fluctuations there inspired by varying U.S. weather forecasts were an additional dampener to trade here.
Swine fever in the Netherlands continued to take its toll on certain products. Afloat citruspulp traded at an historically low level of $70 a tonne. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000
